attribution.note: Marcus states both propositions in his own voice.

semantics.note: The normalization preserves the contemporaneous business-model and operating-cost observations. Neither assertion is conditional or probabilistic.

contract.note: Sustainable profitability is a fair contextual reading because Marcus acknowledges revenue while questioning profits. Treating running costs as inference expenses is ordinary. The contract appropriately avoids inventing a numerical threshold.

evidence.note: Contemporaneous reporting establishes financial uncertainty, but its historical losses, conditional cost assumptions and unknown burn rate do not establish 2023 sustainable economics.
This dated company disclosure establishes customer prices. Lower prices do not establish inference expenses, margins or a durable route to profitability.
The secondary report identifies the older-model basis of the cost estimate. It does not measure GPT-4 inference expenses or establish their implications for sustainable profitability.

reviews.rationale: The packet supplies financial uncertainty, customer pricing and an older-model cost estimate. It lacks comparable target-period economics and GPT-4 inference costs sufficient to establish or refute either component under the fair contextual reading. Uncertain public profitability alone does not prove an unclear route to sustainable profits.
